_note: OOE-APRIME-C-1028 (owner decision OD-1028(38), 2026-10-28: "a' + c"). The ONE source of truth for the layer-2 classifier categories: vera/scope_router.py derives LAYER2_CATEGORIES, REFUSE_CATEGORIES, the refusal precedence and scan spellings, the parser, the disposition logic and the classifier prompt's category list and meanings from this table. OWNER-CURATED and READ-ONLY at runtime: no code path adds or modifies rows (security: the model must never create a research route). Validated on load (unique codes, known dispositions, a rank for each refusing row, aliases colliding with no code or other alias, mutually dissimilar descriptions); an invalid table is a startup error (fail closed). Dispositions: in_scope = answered; off_topic = well-formed out-of-scope verdict (reading list / coverage path); refuse = fixed refusal, never answered, listed or acquired; unsupported_use = fixed unsupported-use sentence plus reading list (also a refusal category: never answered or acquired). refusal_rank = precedence when a reply names several refusal categories (1 = strongest).
aliases_note: OD-1028(38): aliases map a classifier OUTPUT label to a code, never user text. Empty until label logs (scope classifier out-of-enum category: label=...) justify one; each alias is an owner decision.
description_similarity_note: Owner rule 2026-10-28: 'a new C entry must have a significantly dissimlar description from all other descriptions'. Load check: token-set Jaccard of lowercased word tokens, stopwords removed (vera/scope_router.py DESCRIPTION_SIMILARITY_MAX). Calibration on these six descriptions (2026-10-28): pairwise max 0.250 (advice vs harmful: shared 'request', 'defined', 'below'); next 0.125 (programming_task vs rule_change); in_scope vs off_topic 0.083. Threshold 0.50 = max + 0.25 margin (double the max): a pair whose distinct content words overlap by half or more (Jaccard >= 0.50) is rejected. Planner prior, not measured on rejected candidates; re-calibrate when a row is added.
